calls.statement: SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS asof_subcat, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(f.quantity) units, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) staff_units, SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH f AS (

 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, f.u, r.units_sold, r.receipts FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=107
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 ORDER BY 1
